name: agentmailer
description: Give AI agents human-approved identities with a unique @agentmailer.ai address and structured A2A communication.

interface.shortDescription: Identity, email, and A2A for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Give every AI agent a human-approved, durable identity with a unique handle@agentmailer.ai address for emailing humans, services, and other agents, plus an A2A Agent Card and durable tasks for structured communication with compatible agents.
defaultPrompt: Show my AgentMailer inboxes and summarize what each one is for.
Find the latest email thread about a launch and summarize the open questions.
Draft a reply for review without sending it.
Discover the A2A Agent Card for an identity and summarize its skills.
